summary: Implemented the rich.progress open and wrap_file feature. Changes are in rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ProgressFileContext classes, _file_progress helper, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file methods), tests/test_progress.py (20 new tests), docs/source/progress.rst (two new subsections), and CHANGELOG.md (one Unreleased/Added bullet). Nothing was committed. Tests, black, and mypy were not run because the instructions forbade running repository code, so all verification is by reading only. Two choices beyond the spec: the reader defines mode and name properties, because typing.BinaryIO makes them abstract and the class could not be instantiated otherwise; and Progress.open and module-level open carry an extra catch-all str-mode overload so the module-level call type-checks. No type-ignore suppressions were added in the new tests.
